coder_notes: Vaccine plus IL-12 plasmid adjuvant delivered by electroporation device (device not listed as agent). Radiotherapy is outside study scope. Target engagement coded yes for vaccine immunogenicity (neoantigen-specific CD8 T cell response in blood) although the vaccine is not a candidate. Eligibility explicitly allows IDH-mutant secondary glioblastoma, hence historical terminology. Bevacizumab is only mentioned as allowed for oedema, not a registered intervention.
